text: Exor N.V. is the largest shareholder of Iveco Group: 27.1% economic rights and 43.2% voting rights, as of 30 June 2026.
short: Exor holds 27.1% economic / 43.2% voting rights in Iveco Group.

source.name: Exor: Iveco Group (holdings page)
source.note: Exor's own holdings page lists Iveco Group among its companies with these figures 'As of 30/06/2026'.
